A modified '''''Nu''-class attack shuttle''' was used to transport [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] from [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]] to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, it was rendered inoperable before it could even leave Ringo Vinda due to a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|assault]]. The shuttles dorsal wing was adorned with the symbol of the clone medic corps.
